examples.text: "Cash was the best way to teach people about financial knowledge because it's so easy to grasp." Philip Haglund, CEO of Gimi, mentions（mention的第三人称单数）.
examples.translation: “现金是向人们传授财务知识的最佳方式，因为它最容易理解。”Gimi公司首席执行官菲利普·哈格伦德提到。
examples.speechText: "Cash was the best way to teach people about financial knowledge because it's so easy to grasp." Philip Haglund, CEO of Gimi, mentions.

examples.text: Martin Cooper operated a large, heavy, new communication device on a street in New York.
examples.translation: Martin Cooper在纽约的一条街上，操作了一台体积大、重量重的新型通信设备。
examples.speechText: Martin Cooper operated a large, heavy, new communication device on a street in New York.

examples.text: Then, there is the horizontal movement of air across the planet.
examples.translation: 另外，还有空气在地球表面的水平流动。
examples.speechText: Then, there is the horizontal movement of air across the planet.

examples.text: Videos（video的复数形式） of her theatrical demonstrations have attracted hundreds of millions of views across social media platforms.
examples.translation: 她那些富有戏剧性的演示视频，在各大社交媒体平台累计获得了数亿次观看。
examples.speechText: Videos of her theatrical demonstrations have attracted hundreds of millions of views across social media platforms.

examples.text: The reality is that writing is a lonely, private and poor-paying affair.
examples.translation: 现实是，写作是一件孤独、私密而且收入微薄的事情。
examples.speechText: The reality is that writing is a lonely, private and poor-paying affair.

examples.text: People who feel they have unlimited moral choices in their lives when it comes to matters of sex or drugs, for example, tend to be unhappier than those who do not feel they have so many choices in life.
examples.translation: 例如，在性或毒品等问题上，那些觉得自己拥有无限道德选择的人，往往比不认为生活中有如此多选择的人更不快乐。
examples.speechText: People who feel they have unlimited moral choices in their lives when it comes to matters of sex or drugs, for example, tend to be unhappier than those who do not feel they have so many choices in life.

examples.text: Unlike forward walking, which primarily engages the ankles, backward walking shifts the workload to the knees.
examples.translation: 向前走主要调动脚踝，而倒着走会把更多负荷转移到膝盖上。
examples.speechText: Unlike forward walking, which primarily engages the ankles, backward walking shifts the workload to the knees.

examples.text: Post them on a variety of social media, use “#” and catchy titles（title的复数形式） and make sure that they can be easily found.
examples.translation: 把内容发布到多种社交媒体上，使用“#”话题标签和吸引人的标题，确保人们容易找到这些内容。
examples.speechText: Post them on a variety of social media, use “#” and catchy titles and make sure that they can be easily found.

examples.text: Another technique takes embryo (胚胎) cells and develops them into a wide variety of cell types and tissues.
examples.translation: 另一种技术利用胚胎细胞，将其培养成各种不同类型的细胞和组织。
examples.speechText: Another technique takes embryo cells and develops them into a wide variety of cell types and tissues.

examples.text: Since most men have difficulty admitting（admit的-ing形式） loneliness and hurt, they tend to become angry instead.
examples.translation: 由于大多数男性难以承认自己的孤独和受伤，他们往往会转而表现出愤怒。
examples.speechText: Since most men have difficulty admitting loneliness and hurt, they tend to become angry instead.

examples.text: Cooper received an award there for his lifetime of work.
examples.translation: Cooper在那里因其毕生的工作成就而获得了一个奖项。
examples.speechText: Cooper received an award there for his lifetime of work.

examples.text: Thousands of years ago, humans collected nuts（nut的复数形式） and fruits.
examples.translation: 几千年前，人类采集坚果和水果。
examples.speechText: Thousands of years ago, humans collected nuts and fruits.

examples.text: Majesty Palm is used to living under bigger trees（tree的复数形式） in its natural habitat in Madagascar, making it tolerate indirect light.
examples.translation: Majesty Palm棕榈在马达加斯加的原生环境中，习惯生长在更高大的树木下，因此能够适应散射光。
examples.speechText: Majesty Palm is used to living under bigger trees in its natural habitat in Madagascar, making it tolerate indirect light.

examples.text: Sometimes these market days were fixed at every tenth day, sometimes every seventh or every fifth day.
examples.translation: 这些集市日有时定在每隔十天一次，有时每隔七天或五天一次。
examples.speechText: Sometimes these market days were fixed at every tenth day, sometimes every seventh or every fifth day.

examples.text: Lundberg will still listen in from the stairs（stair的复数形式） sometimes, because it's pretty funny.
examples.translation: Lundberg有时仍会在楼梯上听听孩子们打电话，因为这实在很有趣。
examples.speechText: Lundberg will still listen in from the stairs sometimes, because it's pretty funny.
